name: The Masterpiece
source:
The vampiric threat has ended. The Deity Machine lies in ruins, and society can finally breathe.

You and your Fae friend, Isidore, attend Vorsch’s Magical Sideshow, also known as The Masterpiece. The last guests get a rare glimpse behind the curtain…

But the magic isn’t all it seems. Will you survive the night, or will the show consume you?

[From [url=https://hyakuten-games.itch.io/the-masterpiece]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
吸血鬼的威胁已经结束。神机化为废墟，社会终于得以喘息。

你和你的Fae朋友Isidore参加Vorsch的魔法杂耍表演，也称为“杰作”。最后的客人难得一睹幕布后面的风采……

但魔法并不只是看起来那么简单。你能熬过这个夜晚，还是演出会吞噬你？

[来自[url=https://hyakuten-games.itch.io/the-masterpiece]Itch.io[/url]]
